title: Context photography
role: A place, material or actual usage gives scale and context.
cropRules: Use a subject-aware crop at each breakpoint; keep essential text outside complex imagery.
provenance: License/source required; unrelated stock must not impersonate client premises.
delivery: Choose actual output dimensions and format from the display role.
Use responsive sources and avoid blocking the primary action on nonessential art.
Record bytes, dimensions, source and transformations in the project asset manifest.
